positions.as_written: Plan to a mechanical axis target rather than a correction angle alone.
Assess the receiving compartment before correcting load into it.
Confirm the achieved axis radiographically, since the plan and the result can differ.
Treat osteotomy as the mechanical foundation that other procedures are built on, rather than as an alternative to them.
Correct alignment as the foundation for cartilage and meniscal work rather than as an alternative.
Localise the deformity before correcting, and confirm the achieved axis afterwards.
Counsel that the correction changes any later arthroplasty.
Treat slope correction as a separate operation with its own indication.
